name: Dialectical Tonal Polarity Matrix
diagnostic: What opposing behavioral tensions must our brand balance to avoid collapsing into a flat, predictable stereotype?
artifact: Trait tensions: *Deeply Technical* yet *Instantly Plainspoken*; *Pragmatic and Grounded* yet *Uncompromisingly Visionary*.
Calibration bounds marking the point where each extreme turns destructive.
trap: Resolving the tension by softening both sides toward a bland middle ground, erasing distinctiveness.
pedigreeFull: Dialectical philosophy applied to communications architecture, establishing brand identity through the dynamic resolution of opposing traits.
